items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide, not clear and not evidence of compromise. Fleet-doctor has no run or findings; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; security site facts are unknown for all 61 managed sites. Authentication boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. TLS has no recorded certificates expiring within 30 days, but TLS configuration and certificate validation remain unverified. Exact decision: block new public exposure, security-sensitive releases, and gated-product launch changes pending evidence. Permit ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves compliance boundaries.

Continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated evidence, unknowns, affected scope, owners, severity, and release implications for authentication/access, secrets, isolation, release controls, TLS, dependencies and supply chain, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, deploy, add dependencies, request duplicate telemetry, or conduct external outreach.
